# Quest Board

Quest Board turns your to-do list into a game. Create quests, earn XP, level up with humorous titles, keep daily streaks alive, and face the weekly boss gauge. Deadlines are adjustable and finished tasks move to an archive. Built-in tracking for school, health and calendar.
